description: The outcome the request describes, on the real page: one pillars section was duplicated, renamed, and pointed at its own group of cards, so 'What Your Support Powers' and 'How Your Support Will Be Used' are two distinct bands rather than the same three cards twice. Both halves of the feature are visible at once and neither works without the other — the heading comes from each section's own title (the slot bands used to take it from donatePage.json and ignore the title they could already carry), and the cards come from cardsInGroup matching the section's group against each card's. Before this, loadPillars returned every pillar entry to every pillars band, which is why a duplicated section rendered a verbatim second copy. The two bands are ordered directly under the hero, with the narrative section dropped, so both fall inside a viewport-sized capture — the same framing choice the goal-meter scenario makes.
